name: supabase
description: Supabase BaaS — PostgreSQL + RLS + Auth + Storage + Realtime. No separately operated server.

notes.securityBoundary: RLS is the last line of defense. Paired with a frontend that has a server runtime (Next.js, etc.) the application-layer authorization check is applied as a second layer; paired with an SPA, RLS becomes effectively the only boundary — the point where guide content varies most by combination
notes.serverCodeLocation: In the frontend axis's server runtime if it provides one (Route Handlers · Server Actions), otherwise in Edge Functions
